Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Monday
Markets.summary: Indian stock indices rebounded on Friday, driven by strong gains in heavyweight IT stocks following two sessions of losses. Analysts expect range-bound trading ahead, with the Nifty facing resistance near 24,200 and support around 23,900 amid mixed global cues and geopolitical tensions.

Markets.title: Former BJP MP Kirit Somaiya seeks SEBI probe into sharp Sensex swing during CAS
Markets.summary: Former BJP MP Kirit Somaiya has asked SEBI to investigate a sharp, sudden swing in the Sensex during the Closing Auction Session on August 27. He questioned whether the new CAS mechanism, introduced on August 3, has vulnerabilities regarding liquidity and price discovery.

Markets.title: Nifty may be in accumulation phase, says Anand James; Ather, Nazara top bets
Markets.summary: Analysts state the Nifty is currently in an accumulation phase with support expected between 24,000 and 24,100 for the September series. Ather Energy and Nazara Technologies are highlighted as top stock picks following recent bullish momentum.

Markets.title: Bullion braces for fresh swings as US jobs data, Iran tensions take centre stage: Analysts
Markets.summary: Gold prices are expected to face increased volatility in September following a recent decline. Traders are closely monitoring upcoming US job reports, inflation metrics, and Middle East tensions to guide their investment strategies.

Markets.title: 10 largecap stocks with up to 40% upside potential. Do you own any?
Markets.summary: Based on Trendlyne consensus estimates, several BSE large-cap stocks are projected to deliver strong gains over the next 12 months. Some of these companies have an estimated upside potential of up to 40%.

Markets.title: Nifty mega caps are going nowhere. Why Samco CIO Umesh Mehta put 75% of his Flexicap fund beyond largecaps
Markets.summary: Samco CIO Umesh Mehta has allocated 75% of his Flexicap fund to mid- and small-cap stocks because Nifty mega caps are weighed down by high institutional ownership and slowing earnings. He sees better growth opportunities in sectors like defence, power, and AI ancillaries while cautioning against IPO-driven liquidity pressures.

Geo-Political.title: Eight killed and others missing after ferry capsizes off northern Cyprus
Geo-Political.summary: A ferry carrying nearly 270 people capsized shortly after leaving a port off northern Cyprus. The incident resulted in eight deaths and left multiple passengers missing while rescue operations continued.

Geo-Political.title: Iceland votes against restarting EU membership talks
Geo-Political.summary: Voters in Iceland rejected a government proposal to restart accession talks with the European Union. According to broadcaster RUV, 52.8 percent of the electorate voted against resuming membership negotiations.

Geo-Political.title: Manhunt after shooting at Swiss rave kills woman, 22, and injures five
Geo-Political.summary: A gunman killed a 22-year-old woman and injured five other people in their twenties at a techno event near Zurich. Police launched a manhunt to find the suspect responsible for the shooting.

Geo-Political.title: Nasa launches new space telescope able to see 100 times more than Hubble
Geo-Political.summary: NASA launched a new space telescope with 100 times the capability of the Hubble Space Telescope. The telescope will spend multiple years mapping the universe to study dark energy and dark matter.

Geo-Political.title: Canada installs large Lake Ontario sign in latest jab at US
Geo-Political.summary: Ontario Premier Doug Ford unveiled a billboard on the Canadian shore of Lake Ontario bearing the message "Lake Ontario. Now and Always." This sign was installed as the latest political jab at the United States.

Geo-Political.title: Russia says it helped to repel Niger attempted coup
Geo-Political.summary: Russia stated that it helped Niger repel an attempted military coup on Saturday. Authorities reported that soldiers attacked a key military base early in the morning, but the assault was thwarted.

Data & Insights.title: India-US trade in focus? Commerce Ministry calls exporters for September 1 meeting: Report
Data & Insights.summary: India's Commerce Ministry has scheduled a meeting with exporters and industry groups on September 1. The purpose of the meeting is to assess trade and tariff concerns between India and the United States.

Data & Insights.title: PM Modi in Tashkent: India, Uzbekistan seek to unlock next phase of $1.5 billion trade ties
Data & Insights.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited Tashkent to discuss expanding economic relations between India and Uzbekistan. Both nations currently share $1.5 billion in bilateral trade and aim to double this figure to $3 billion within three years.

Data & Insights.title: GST Council sets date for first meeting since rationalisation last year
Data & Insights.summary: The GST Council has scheduled its 57th meeting for September 12 in New Delhi. This gathering follows a preparatory officers' meeting on September 11.

Data & Insights.title: India to start preparations for Budget 2027 from 12 October
Data & Insights.summary: India will begin pre-budget consultations for the 2027 fiscal year on October 12. Finance Secretary (Expenditure) V. Vualnam will chair these upcoming preparation meetings.

Data & Insights.title: India forex reserves hit record high on RBI steps to attract US dollars
Data & Insights.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves have reached a record high following measures by the Reserve Bank of India to attract US dollars. This increase provides the central bank with greater ability to support the rupee, which continues to be one of Asia's worst-performing currencies.

Data & Insights.title: Industrial output growth narrows to 6.7% in July from 8.8% in June
Data & Insights.summary: India's industrial output growth slowed to 6.7% in July from 8.8% in June, driven by a dip in mining. Despite this moderation, overall growth remained strong, supported by the manufacturing and capital goods sectors.

India.title: BJP Leader, 1984 Riots Lawyer Slams Party MPs Over Sajjan Kumar House Visit
India.summary: A BJP leader and 1984 riots lawyer criticized three party MPs for visiting the house of Sajjan Kumar. In response, BJP National President Nitin Nabin summoned and reprimanded the MPs for violating the party's stance on the riots.

India.title: No Food Discussion, No Fatwas: VHP On Reports Of Satvik Food On Durga Puja
India.summary: The Vishwa Hindu Parishad (VHP) has denied issuing any directives regarding the consumption of "satvik" food during Durga Puja. A VHP leader clarified that the organization did not issue such instructions and does not issue fatwas.

India.title: 'No Strict Action': Akal Takht Leader Tears Into AAP Over Punjab Drug Issue
India.summary: An Akal Takht leader criticized the AAP government for failing to take strict action against Punjab's drug problem. He stated that the Akal Takht can provide data on individuals battling drug addiction in various villages to anyone claiming drugs no longer exist in the state.

India.title: Bengaluru Techie Dead, Friend Hurt As Both Fall From 7th Floor After Dispute
India.summary: A techie named Janani died after falling from the seventh floor of a Bengaluru building following a dispute. Her friend, Manichavelu, survived the fall after landing on tree branches before hitting the ground.

India.title: Nepal Flash Flood Speed Was 300 Kmph, Experts Warn Of A Second Deluge
India.summary: Experts warn that a second deluge could occur in Nepal because fresh rockfalls might trigger a cascading impact across three lakes. They note that the only way to prevent this disaster is through a controlled release of water, which is not yet taking place.

India.title: DNA Experts Reach Flood-Hit Nepal, Gujarat Team Ready For Identification
India.summary: DNA experts have arrived in flood-hit Nepal to assist with disaster relief. Additionally, a team in Gandhinagar, Gujarat, is prepared to process biological specimens and conduct round-the-clock DNA matching for identification purposes.

General.title: Prisoners freed early are returning to jail at rapid rate, governors tell BBC
General.summary: Governors have informed the BBC that prisoners released early are returning to jail at a rapid rate. In response to this trend, Prime Minister Andy Burnham announced changes to the October early release scheme to ensure that PC Harper's killers remain incarcerated.

General.title: Eight killed and others missing after ferry capsizes off northern Cyprus
General.summary: A ferry carrying nearly 270 people capsized after leaving port off northern Cyprus. Eight people were killed and others remain missing as search and rescue operations continue.

General.title: 'A giant leap forward': Nasa launches powerful new space telescope to explore mysteries of the Universe
General.summary: NASA launched a powerful new space telescope to begin a multi-year mission mapping the universe. The telescope will study dark energy and dark matter to help scientists better understand cosmic mysteries.

General.title: Sons of officer who died in A66 crash lead out Man Utd as mascots
General.summary: The sons of late police officer PC Matthew Blades served as mascots for Manchester United. They led the team onto the pitch at Old Trafford for Sunday's Premier League match against Ipswich.

General.title: Church names pastor killed by falling sign at Christian festival
General.summary: Robert Guanco, a 41-year-old pastor at Jesus the Living Water Church in Eastbourne, was killed by a falling sign. The fatal accident occurred at a Christian festival.

General.title: British woman killed in stabbing at German railway station
General.summary: A 27-year-old German man was arrested immediately after the incident in Rosenheim, Bavaria.
